question: ৭২. Choose the correct one.

answers.text: ক. Let he, you an I go there
খ. Let I, you and he go there
গ. Let you, him and me go there

question: ৭৫. Identify the correct passive form of the sentence “Open the door”.

answers.text: ক. Let the door is opened
খ. Let the door be opened
গ. Let the door be open
ঘ. The door should be opened

hint: Imperative sentence-এর passive রূপ হলো 'Let + object + be + past participle'.
